$schema.description: Path or URL to khora-config.schema.json. Purely for editor IntelliSense; ignored at runtime.

extends.description: Path(s) to base config files relative to this file. Recursively resolved; deeper bases merge first.

baseUrl.description: KHORA host base URL. Default: http://127.0.0.1:8787

registryUrl.description: Khora registry URL for khora link. Default: http://localhost:4000

registryHostSlug.description: Fallback registry host slug when baseUrl lookup fails during link.

currentHost.description: Selected Khora host slug (khora host use).

hosts.description: Local host aliases and cached catalog entries keyed by slug.

agentKeyPath.description: Override path to the Ed25519 identity file. Default: ~/.khora/identity.json

dataDir.description: Root directory for relative plugin paths (filePath, dir, dbPath).

daemonJson.description: (daemon only) Emit JSON lines instead of pretty-printed events.

plugins.description: Builtin plugins by id. Merged across layers per-id; set an id to false to cancel.

khora.plugin.profile-sync.description: profile-sync plugin options, or false to disable an inherited entry.

filePath.description: Path to the profile JSON file. Resolved against dataDir when relative.

pollIntervalMs.description: Re-flush interval (ms). Omit to only flush on subscribed events.

khora.plugin.telemetry.description: telemetry plugin options, or false to disable an inherited entry.

dir.description: Directory for rotated JSONL telemetry. Resolved against dataDir when relative.

maxFileBytes.description: Rotate when the next line would exceed this size. Default 4194304 (4 MiB).

khora.plugin.inbox-buffer.description: inbox-buffer plugin options, or false to disable an inherited entry.

dbPath.description: SQLite file path. Resolved against dataDir when relative. Use ':memory:' for ephemeral runs.

compactPolicy.description: Eviction policy applied after each append (or on demand).

maxEntries.description: Cap on retained rows; oldest dropped first.
